statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-68076 (GHSA-75mg-c62r-v95g): in Apache Airflow before 3.3.1, the environment-variable secrets backend could resolve a team-scoped Connection or Variable from another team's scope, so in multi-team mode, with [core] test_connection set to Enabled (it ships Disabled) and team-scoped secrets provisioned as environment variables in the API server, a user of one team could have POST /api/v2/connections/test authenticate outward with another team's credentials. Upstream fixed it in 3.3.1 with pull request 70736 and pull request 70902, backported to the 3.3 branch as commits 386f5eb3a04b9fec6fe7589d3c422c12039013c3 and ccb7782c507c92d7db8473451ee4c6ecaff818b8 (pull requests 70882 and 71041); together with the follow-up commit 03377d5d7f83e1456df425c6df1bed548dd015ff, also in 3.3.1, they make the backend in airflow/secrets/environment_variables.py refuse, when multi_team is on, any secret id containing the ___ team separator before either lookup: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-75mg-c62r-v95g, https://lists.apache.org/thread/v4mc51dgmrc1t82mhzsngsgzo2gxsf2l, https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70736, https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70902, https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/386f5eb3a04b9fec6fe7589d3c422c12039013c3, https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/ccb7782c507c92d7db8473451ee4c6ecaff818b8, https://github.com/apache/airflow/releases/tag/3.3.1 . We unpacked every package built from the airflow source in the DHI Debian 13 repository (the airflow package), 52 versions from 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-11 for amd64 and arm64, and checked every download against the index SHA256. The dist-info metadata shows apache-airflow and apache-airflow-core 3.3.0 in 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.0-3 and apache-airflow and apache-airflow-core 3.3.1, 3.3.2 and 3.4.0 in every build from 3.3.1-0 on. We also searched the shipped Python sources for the fix: the TEAM_SEP separator check (return TEAM_SEP in secret_id) in environment_variables.py is absent from every 3.3.0 build and present in every build from 3.3.1-0 on, on both architectures. Every build also ships a compiled environment_variables.cpython-313.pyc; in 3.3.0-3 and 3.3.1-0 on both architectures its header records the same source size and modification time as the shipped source, so it was compiled from that source. FIXED at 3.3.1-0.
